"""Capture the e7dd6648 oracles for SPEC-hm-light-lane-s3a, before any template or module changed.

Run with the e7dd6648 source first on the path and this repo's tests second, from a detached
worktree of e7dd6648 (`git worktree add --detach <dir> e7dd6648`):

    PYTHONPATH=<dir>/src:<repo> <repo>/.venv/bin/python <this file> <repo>/tests/fixtures/light_lane_s3a <repo>/.claude/harness.yaml

It writes three goldens:
- boundary_e7dd6648.json — AC-004: the SHA-256 of `hm autopilot_caps boundary`'s JSON, ledger
  rows and marker (volatile fields masked, `observation_sha`) for every case of
  `light_lane_s3a_fixture.ac004_cases()`, with the full observation kept for every execute case
  and for verify's default-pipeline auto_full case (AC-003's E7DD_KEYS and merge_gate oracle);
- digest_e7dd6648.json — AC-012: `world_model_digest.next_stage` on DIGEST_CASES;
- renders_e7dd6648.json — AC-011 SHAs of the unchanged paths over CONFIGS, the Claude execute
  command length (AC-007), verify Checks 2/4/6 sliced by heading and review Step 2's drift rule
  (AC-008), spec Step 0's exempt command (AC-014) and the autopilot ledger EVENTS (AC-013).
"""
import hashlib, json, sys, tempfile
from itertools import product
from pathlib import Path

import harness_maker
from harness_maker.observability import verification_cache

assert "/src/harness_maker" in harness_maker.__file__, harness_maker.__file__
SOURCE = Path(harness_maker.__file__).resolve()
verification_cache._tool_versions = lambda root: {}  # speed only; no golden carries a key

from tests.unit import light_lane_s3a_fixture as fx

out_dir, harness_yaml = Path(sys.argv[1]), Path(sys.argv[2])

# ── AC-004 boundary ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
boundary = {"source_sha": "e7dd6648", "cases": {}}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
    old = fx.isolate_env(Path(td) / "home")
    for i, case in enumerate(fx.ac004_cases()):
        root = Path(td) / f"c{i}"
        argv = fx.build(root, case)
        obs = fx.observe(root, argv)
        boundary["cases"][case.key] = {"sha256": fx.observation_sha(obs)}
        if fx.keeps_observation(case):
            boundary["cases"][case.key]["observation"] = obs
(out_dir / "boundary_e7dd6648.json").write_text(json.dumps(boundary, indent=1, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
print("boundary cases:", len(boundary["cases"]))

# ── AC-012 digest ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
from harness_maker import world_model_digest
digest = {"source_sha": "e7dd6648", "cases": {}}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
    fx.isolate_env(Path(td) / "home")
    for i, (name, lane, record, fresh) in enumerate(fx.DIGEST_CASES):
        root = Path(td) / f"d{i}"
        fx.build_digest(root, lane, record, fresh)
        digest["cases"][name] = world_model_digest.next_stage(root, fx.SLUG, root)
(out_dir / "digest_e7dd6648.json").write_text(json.dumps(digest, indent=1) + "\n")
print("digest:", digest["cases"])

# ── AC-011 / AC-007 / AC-008 / AC-014 renders ─────────────────────────────
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(sys.argv[0]).resolve().parents[3]))
from tests.structural._surface_baseline import pinned_install_ref
from harness_maker import autopilot_ledger
from harness_maker.interview import answers_from_harness_yaml
from harness_maker.models import LoopConfig, Preset, ProjectProfile
from harness_maker.render import DEFAULT_FREEZE_TIME, render
from harness_maker.synthesize import synthesize

MECH = ["uv run ruff check .", "uv run pytest -q"]
UNCHANGED = (
    "commands/hm/review.md", "commands/hm/verify.md", "commands/hm/wrapup.md", "commands/hm/loop.md",
    "hm/verify-checks.md", "hm/wrapup-steps.md", "hm/review-autofix.md", "hm/review-confirmation.md",
    "skills/hm-review", "skills/hm-verify", "skills/hm-wrapup",
)
DRIFT_SENTENCE = (
    "Drift findings get severity `P1` and surface in the REVIEW report; reviewers still run on "
    "the actual diff.\n\n"
)

def config_key(loop, wt, strictness, mech, preset):
    return f"loop-{'on' if loop else 'off'}/wt-{'on' if wt else 'off'}/{strictness}/mech-{'set' if mech else 'unset'}/{preset}"

def section(text, start, ends):
    i = text.index("\n" + start + "\n") + 1
    j = min(text.index("\n" + e, i) + 1 for e in ends if ("\n" + e) in text[i:])
    return text[i:j]

def read(root, rel):
    if rel.startswith("skills/"):
        p = root / ".agents" / "skills" / rel.split("/", 1)[1] / "SKILL.md"
    else:
        p = root / ".claude" / rel
    return p.read_text() if p.is_file() else None

texts: dict[str, str] = {}
def keep(t):
    h = hashlib.sha256(t.encode()).hexdigest()
    texts[h] = t
    return h

renders = {"source_sha": "e7dd6648", "unchanged_paths": list(UNCHANGED), "configs": {}, "texts": texts,
           "events": sorted(autopilot_ledger.EVENTS)}
base = answers_from_harness_yaml(harness_yaml)
for loop, wt, strictness, mech, preset in product((False, True), (False, True), ("warn", "block"), (False, True), ("Side", "Production")):
    answers = base.model_copy(update={
        "loop": LoopConfig(enabled=loop),
        "worktree": {**base.worktree, "enabled": wt},
        "strictness": strictness,
        "mechanical_checks": list(MECH) if mech else [],
        "preset": Preset(preset),
    })
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        root = Path(td)
        with pinned_install_ref():
            render(synthesize(ProjectProfile(), answers), root / ".claude", freeze_time=DEFAULT_FREEZE_TIME)
        cfg = {"sha256": {}, "checks": {}, "drift_rule": {}, "exempt_cmd": {}}
        for rel in UNCHANGED:
            t = read(root, rel)
            cfg["sha256"][rel] = None if t is None else hashlib.sha256(t.encode()).hexdigest()
        execute = read(root, "commands/hm/execute.md")
        cfg["execute_chars"] = len(execute)
        cfg["execute_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(execute.encode()).hexdigest()
        for arm, verify_text, review_text, spec_text in (
            ("claude", read(root, "hm/verify-checks.md"), read(root, "commands/hm/review.md"), read(root, "commands/hm/spec.md")),
            ("codex", read(root, "skills/hm-verify"), read(root, "skills/hm-review"), read(root, "skills/hm-spec")),
        ):
            cfg["checks"][arm] = {
                "2": keep(section(verify_text, "### Check 2 — Regression smoke", ["### Check 3"])),
                "4": keep(section(verify_text, "### Check 4 — Security high findings", ["<!-- @hm:loop-only -->", "### Check 5", "### Check 6"])),
                "6": keep(section(verify_text, "### Check 6 — SPEC requirement", ["## Advisory probes"])),
            }
            step2 = section(review_text, "### Step 2 — Drift gate (PLAN/SPEC vs actual diff) — SINGLE OWNER", ["### Step 3"])
            body = step2.split("\n", 2)[2]
            assert DRIFT_SENTENCE in body
            cfg["drift_rule"][arm] = keep(body.replace(DRIFT_SENTENCE, ""))
            line = next(ln for ln in spec_text.splitlines() if "spec_machine approve" in ln and "--exempt" in ln)
            cfg["exempt_cmd"][arm] = line
        renders["configs"][config_key(loop, wt, strictness, mech, preset)] = cfg
(out_dir / "renders_e7dd6648.json").write_text(json.dumps(renders, indent=1, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
print("render configs:", len(renders["configs"]), "unique texts:", len(texts))
